article_title: I get paid £120,000 a year to make social media videos go viral

tasks.prompt: What is the article mainly about?
options: Why traditional television adverts have disappeared completely
How professional clippers turn long videos into short social-media clips, creating income opportunities but not guaranteed success
Why musicians are refusing to use short-form video
How social-media platforms pay every young user £120,000 a year
tasks.correct_answer: How professional clippers turn long videos into short social-media clips, creating income opportunities but not guaranteed success
tasks.explanation_hebrew: הכתבה מציגה את עבודת ה־clippers, את פוטנציאל ההכנסה והיתרונות ללקוחות, אך גם מדגישה שרוב העוסקים אינם מרוויחים הרבה.

tasks.prompt: How does a clipper usually create content for a client?
options: By watching a longer video, selecting strong moments and turning them into 30-to-60-second vertical clips
By filming a new feature-length movie for each platform
By copying traditional adverts without editing them
By uploading only audio recordings to social media
tasks.correct_answer: By watching a longer video, selecting strong moments and turning them into 30-to-60-second vertical clips
tasks.explanation_hebrew: העבודה מתחילה בצפייה בסרטון ארוך, בחירת הקטעים הטובים ביותר ועריכתם לסרטונים אנכיים של 30–60 שניות.

tasks.prompt: What does “lucrative” mean when the article describes clipping?
options: Difficult to learn
Likely to attract criticism
Capable of producing a lot of money
Limited to professional musicians
tasks.correct_answer: Capable of producing a lot of money
tasks.explanation_hebrew: lucrative פירושו רווחי מאוד; קליפ שמצליח לצבור צפיות רבות יכול להכניס סכום משמעותי.

tasks.prompt: What first convinced Eknoor Singh that clipping could be highly profitable?
options: He was hired by HBO Max before making any clips.
He received a university degree in social-media editing.
He earned $300 from posting a short Dua Lipa video on Instagram.
He sold his mobile phone for £10,000.
tasks.correct_answer: He earned $300 from posting a short Dua Lipa video on Instagram.
tasks.explanation_hebrew: סינג סיפר שהרוויח 300 דולר מסרטון קצר של דואה ליפה, ואז הבין מיד את פוטנציאל הרווח.

tasks.prompt: Why do some companies prefer hiring young clippers to buying traditional social-media adverts?
options: Young clippers are legally required to work for free.
They may understand short-video audiences better and can generate attention at lower cost.
Traditional adverts cannot appear on Instagram or YouTube.
Clippers guarantee that every post will go viral.
tasks.correct_answer: They may understand short-video audiences better and can generate attention at lower cost.
tasks.explanation_hebrew: החברות מקוות שהיכרות הצעירים עם קהל הסרטונים הקצרים תייצר צפיות רבות, לעיתים במחיר נמוך מפרסום מסורתי.

tasks.prompt: What is an “intermediary website” in the clipping business?
options: A platform that connects clippers with companies offering video jobs
A website used only to watch full-length films
A government agency that sets social-media salaries
A tool that guarantees one million views
tasks.correct_answer: A platform that connects clippers with companies offering video jobs
tasks.explanation_hebrew: intermediary הוא גורם מתווך; האתרים מציגים עבודות זמינות ומחברים בין מותגים לבין עורכי הקליפים.

tasks.prompt: What benefits and demands does Ethan Weems associate with clipping?
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לציין שהוא מרוויח לפחות אלף דולר בחודש, עובד מהבית ומבלה יותר עם משפחתו, אך שהצלחה דורשת צפייה ממושכת והיכרות עמוקה עם התוכן.
expected_points: Weems says clipping brings him at least $1,000 a month.
It supplements his other video-making work.
Working from home gives him more time with his wife and young son.
The article warns that successful clippers may spend many hours watching content.

tasks.prompt: Summarise how clipping works as a business for workers, clients and intermediary platforms.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש להסביר כיצד הקליפר מקבל תוכן ארוך ויוצר קטעים קצרים, כיצד השכר קשור לצפיות, מה מרוויחים הלקוחות ומה תפקיד אתרי התיווך.
expected_points: Clients provide or promote longer content that clippers turn into short vertical videos.
Clippers upload selected moments to platforms and may be paid according to views.
Brands gain relatively cheap promotion designed for younger short-form audiences.
Intermediary sites list jobs, connect the parties and may charge companies a fee.

tasks.prompt: Why does the article warn readers not to treat Singh's income as typical?
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש להסתמך על דברי הביקורת: רוב היוצרים מרוויחים מעט או כלום, נדרשות שעות רבות, ההצלחה תלויה בצפיות ורק מעטים מגיעים להכנסה גבוהה.
expected_points: Singh is presented as a particularly successful example.
Consultant Lia Haberman says the vast majority in the creator economy make little or nothing.
Payment depends on obtaining large numbers of views, which is uncertain.
Analyst Devin Nash says success requires extensive time watching and understanding content.

tasks.prompt: Write a balanced short career note for someone considering clipping as a side job.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש להציג יתרונות כגון עבודה מרחוק ופוטנציאל הכנסה לצד הסיכון להכנסה נמוכה, התלות בצפיות והזמן הרב הנדרש.
expected_points: Describe the basic task of finding engaging moments in long videos and editing short vertical clips.
Mention flexible remote work and possible earnings from successful clips.
Warn that most people may earn little and that viral success is not guaranteed.
Note the need for many hours of viewing, platform knowledge and consistent output.
